botster.register{
  handlers = {{ kind = "mcp_tool", id = "h_t", name = "t", description = "d", input_schema = { type = "object" },
    call = function(payload, request)

      local missing = {}
      for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        local area, name = string.match(n, "^([%w_]+)%.([%w_]+)$")
        local found
        if area then
          found = botster[area] ~= nil and botster[area][name] ~= nil
        else
          found = botster[n] ~= nil
        end
        if not found then missing[#missing + 1] = n end
      end
      return { checked = #names, missing = #missing, first_missing = missing[1] }
    end }},
}
